method.confirmation_order: Per boundary: before r3, after r3, after r4, before r4. Parent isolation: before r5, after r5, after r6, before r6.
method.aggregation: Equal-weight average of all available per-run means/medians for each case; not a pooled distribution. All outliers retained.

method.scopes: Hot excludes fixture construction/publication, DB and sink I/O. Cold includes cleanup/barrier, task creation, tree build from parsed rules, encoding/registration/Cachex publication; excludes DB/parsing.
